NOTE
**Still not ready — only part of the last review was addressed**

New: Pushed once, dropping the six per-severity fixtures, which fits Niloth's advice to use one fixture. Missing: no `doc.md` change is in the PR's files, and the description still says the feature relies on the `include_emoji_indicators` parameter, which the author said they removed. The author also never answered Niloth's questions about which existing emoji integrations they studied.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays; the author should fix these before Niloth (who gave the feedback) or PieterCK (assigned) takes another look.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @tmvalijib24! Before we review again, please update `doc.md` and the PR description to match what the code now does, as in the existing emoji integrations (see the [incoming webhooks guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/index.html)), and answer Niloth's questions about which of those PRs you followed.
```
